subject: general
question: In February 2023, which State Government’s cabinet has approved the new excise policy under which ‘ahatas’, or areas for drinking attached to liquor outlets, and shop bars will be closed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In February 2023, the Madhya Pradesh State Government's cabinet approved a new excise policy that includes the closure of **'ahatas'** (areas for drinking attached to liquor outlets) and shop bars.
 
• **Ahatas** are designated areas for drinking that are often attached to liquor outlets.
 
• **The new policy mandates the closure of these areas to discourage public drinking and promote a more responsible drinking culture.**
 
• The** government aims **to create a safer environment and reduce public disturbances related to alcohol consumption.
 
• The policy also calls for the closure of **shop bars**, which are small establishments selling liquor for immediate consumption.
 
• This** move is intended to limit the accessibility of alcohol and curb binge drinking.**
 
• The main objectives are to reduce alcohol-related social issues, enhance public safety, and promote responsible drinking practices.
